veranderings.voor: dig teen mekaar en party is baie hoog
veranderings.na: dig teen mekaar, en party is baie hoog
veranderings.rede: AWS 2017: 'en' joins two clauses each with its own subject and verb ('Die geboue staan' / 'party is'), so a comma goes before it, as the lesson already does elsewhere.

veranderings.blok: Hoekom mense juis daar woon en hoe plekke verander
veranderings.rede: 'oor tyd' is a calque of English 'over time'; Afrikaans says 'met die tyd' (or 'mettertyd').

veranderings.blok: Hoekom mense juis daar woon en hoe plekke verander
veranderings.rede: 'want' makes the town's growth the reason work attracts people, which reverses the logic; a colon presents the mine or factory as the example without a false cause.
'rondom' with nothing after it reads as an unfinished preposition; 'daar rondom' is the natural adverbial form.

veranderings.voor: help mekaar met veiligheid en in noodgevalle
veranderings.na: help mekaar om veilig te bly en ook in noodgevalle
veranderings.rede: 'help mekaar met veiligheid' is wooden and English-shaped ('help with safety'); 'om veilig te bly' says the same thing naturally.

vlae.blok: Hoekom mense juis daar woon en hoe plekke verander
vlae.teks: Mense het na water gesoek en na grond waarop gewasse kan groei.
vlae.rede: The block opens in the past tense with no time marker, and only the later 'Vandag' shows it means people long ago choosing where to settle; a time word would make it clear, but adding one is the writer's call, not a language edit.
